about_the_game:
picoCAD is a 3D modelling tool that lets you make low poly models with a unique aesthetic,

KEY FEATURES

  • Focused toolset: Create retro-style models without any prior experience

  • Built-in texture editor: See your pixel art appear on model as you draw it

  • Unique aesthetic: Embrace the charm of low-poly, low-res visuals

  • GIF export: Instantly share animations on social media

  • OBJ export: Bring your models into any modern game engine

  • Community-driven: Join a helpful and friendly Discord full of creators. Together de decide which features to do next

      

WHAT'S NEW?

Re-written from scratch, picoCAD 2 offers a lot of improvements over the original. Think NES to SNES. Here are some highlights:

  • No project size limits: Build as big (or small) as you want

  • New texture editor: Fully integrated with your workflow

  • Per-pixel depth sorting: Clean visuals with no z-fighting

  • Palette and shading editors: Fine-tune your color ramps and lighting style

  • Mesh visibility toggles: Hide/show parts of your model as needed

  • Custom GIF settings: Control resolution, duration, and loop style

  • Refined interface: Better layout, fonts, and readability
